customer_segment: Individual knowledge workers and teams using productivity and knowledge-management tools to manage notes, projects, and shared knowledge (E6).
end_activity: Regularly maintain and use a living workspace (personal or shared) that supports ongoing knowledge capture, organization, and team execution (E13).

activities.activity: Discover and consider a workspace tool through word-of-mouth, online content, and/or by encountering it via other tools
activities.current_provider: Self + peers/communities + online content; Notion’s presence via integrations/mentions
activities.customer_goal: Find a credible tool that seems likely to fit the user’s note/knowledge/project workflow before investing setup effort

activities.activity: Sign up and complete initial onboarding to access the workspace
activities.customer_goal: Get into the product quickly and understand enough to start building without high setup friction

activities.activity: Set up the workspace structure (e.g., templates/pages/databases/tags/links) to match the user’s way of working
activities.current_provider: Notion (with the user doing configuration work)
activities.customer_goal: Create an information architecture that will make future retrieval, reuse, and collaboration easier

activities.activity: Create and store work artifacts (notes, databases, wikis, project boards)
activities.customer_goal: Capture knowledge and track work in a format that is easy to edit and evolve

activities.activity: Collaborate by sharing, commenting, and coordinating tasks on shared pages
activities.customer_goal: Align teammates around the same source of truth and coordinate execution without duplication

activities.activity: Integrate the workspace with external apps and continuously iterate/update the system over time
activities.current_provider: Notion + connected external apps (e.g., Slack/Google Drive) + the user’s ongoing maintenance behaviors
activities.customer_goal: Keep the workspace current and connected to the rest of the toolchain so it remains useful as work changes

profile_vs_cvc_conflicts: Notion is positioned as an “all-in-one workspace,” but the observed customer behavior includes connecting Notion to external apps as part of normal use, implying many customers operate a multi-tool workflow rather than fully replacing the bundle (E6, E12).
